title: Recovery: bounded correlated backup admission and exact verification results
body:
## Current disposition — 2026-10-06

Correlated bounded backup admission and exact terminal verification are implemented through merged #1330 (`adb6d1b978897b935c21a06b96eef3079865cfbf`). The separately authorized #1410 journey subsequently created and verified one exact backup and verified it with the adopted reader. The historical uncorrelated POST remains unassociated; no successful result is reconstructed for it. A verified backup is not a restore test, and its cutoff excludes later notes. No backup/restore action is performed by this administrative closeout.

This user-authorized reconciliation is tracked in #1209. Earlier scopes and evidence below are preserved verbatim as history; their then-current Draft/open wording is superseded only by this disposition. No source/runtime, verification, provider, migration, deployment or merge operation is performed by closing this issue.

---

## Preserved earlier task and evidence record

Recovery admission and status currently wait for synchronous full backup validation. The reported incident had an 8.026-second inventory scan behind a five-second product response deadline; a completed backup could not be confirmed through the normal recovery page. The historical POST has no durable caller-request correlation and must remain unassociated.

Implement bounded authenticated admission with caller-retained correlation, a supervisor-owned finite child process for the unchanged complete backup/verification owners, genuinely read-only metadata status, and exact terminal results consumed by the normal recovery page. Support explicit fresh verification of an existing exact backup without creating another backup.

Preserve replay/conflict and project/application isolation, filesystem/process ownership, every validator, publication/retention/bookkeeping and cleanup, restore/update authorization and revalidation, five-second control deadlines, bounded payloads, and truthful unknown/interrupted outcomes. Accepted/running status, inventory metadata and historical verified flags are not current checkpoint confirmation. No automatic retry or polling, general job system, validation optimization, Core record, grant, or provider call.

Use disposable production-shaped state for responsiveness, replay/lost-response, failure/timeout/interruption, exact-target freshness and Browser regressions. Follow current exact-base/head Local Canonical policy. Deliver a Draft PR only; no production backup/verification, install, service replacement, adoption, merge or deployment.
